scenarios.scenario_abstract: After choosing Dubai for a ten-day summer adventure, [X] removes the costly skydive while keeping early-morning jet skiing, indoor diving or flying, a desert safari, and water-based days that remain workable in extreme heat.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 选择去迪拜度过十天夏季冒险之旅后，[X]会删去昂贵的高空跳伞，同时保留清晨水上摩托、室内潜水或飞行体验、沙漠越野和避开酷热时段的水上活动。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Already spending mostly solo time kayaking, reading, and playing video games, [X] has twenty hours a week and a $200 starting budget for a related pursuit and seeks the same mix of outdoor exploration, quiet immersion, and skill progression without losing the water-centered interest already sustained.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]平时主要独自划皮划艇、阅读和玩游戏，每周还能投入二十小时，入门预算为两百美元，因此想寻找兼具户外探索、安静沉浸和技能成长的新爱好，同时保留已经长期坚持的亲水兴趣。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After choosing the Dolomites, [X] builds an Innsbruck-to-Italy route around ridge walks, alpine trailheads, cable-car access, mountain refuges, and recovery meals, using village and lake stops to pace strenuous hiking days.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 选择多洛米蒂后，[X]会规划从因斯布鲁克进入意大利的路线，以山脊徒步、登山口、缆车和山间小屋为主线，再用村镇与湖边停留调节高强度徒步日程。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Soon after retirement, [X] explicitly rejects hiking and prefers quiet crosswords, jigsaws, and logic games, beginning with a small online group before easing into a similarly intimate local meetup rather than adopting an athletic retirement routine.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚退休时，[X]会明确拒绝徒步，更喜欢填字、拼图和逻辑游戏，并准备先加入小型线上小组，再逐步参加同样人数不多的本地聚会，而不是把退休生活改造成运动计划。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a next-weekend Alexandria shore session specifically targeting gilthead seabream, [X] refines the rod, reel, line, bottom rig, fresh bait, safe access to rocks or harbor edges, and a minimal first-aid kit for cuts and slippery footing.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备下周末在亚历山大岸边专钓金头鲷时，[X]会逐步确定鱼竿、绕线轮、鱼线、底钓线组和鲜饵，同时考虑礁石或港边通行、湿滑落脚点和处理小伤口的精简急救包。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] anchors a central North Carolina road trip with a historic mine visit and a round at Long Iron Golf, then extends the route to the Atlantic while protecting an early, cooler tee time from summer heat, beach traffic, and lodging changes.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]会把北卡罗来纳中部行程固定在历史金矿参观和 Long Iron Golf 的一轮球局上，随后再延伸到大西洋海岸，并在调整住宿和路线时保留避开暑热与海滩车流的清晨开球时间。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While playing recreational soccer, [X] fits three gym sessions, affordable meals, hydration, and recovery around one or two weekly practices, avoids heavy leg work before the field session, and increases easy-to-digest carbohydrates around training and matches.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加业余足球活动时，[X]会把三次健身、平价饮食、补水和恢复安排在每周一到两次足球训练周围，避免赛前重练腿部，并在训练与比赛前后增加易消化碳水。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After spending most working hours at a desk, [X] tries to become active by comparing gradual pavement running, hilly or interval-based city cycling, and public-pool swimming across knee load, intensity, weather, social support, commute fit, and recovery before distributing short sessions through a crowded week.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在工作中长期久坐后，[X]希望恢复运动，因此会在循序渐进的路跑、带坡度或间歇的城市骑行和公共泳池游泳之间比较膝关节负担、强度、天气、同伴、通勤适配与恢复，再把短时训练分散到繁忙的一周。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At the start of archery, [X] builds a range routine around consistent target shooting, compares bow mechanisms, varied distances, competition pressure, and three-dimensional targets, and selects durable beginner arrows for controlled practice rather than assuming a hunting use.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始射箭时，[X]会围绕稳定的靶场练习比较不同弓型、靶距、比赛压力和三维靶，并在购买入门箭时优先适配可控的靶射训练，而不把尚未选择的狩猎用途强加进来。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: To address inconsistent basketball shooting, [X] corrects knee bend, repeats a stable free-throw routine, drills layups from both sides, and improves ball handling, then tests the practice in games and considers joining a local league for more live repetitions.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 针对篮球投篮不稳定的问题，[X]会调整屈膝发力，重复固定的罚球流程，练习左右两侧上篮并加强控球，随后在实战中检验训练成果，并考虑加入本地联赛增加对抗机会。
